section.11: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

11.name_native: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:"Abu Bakr and Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, and the one who was better than them prostrated during 'When the heaven is split asunder' and 'Read! In the name of your Lord
